production-deployment/recap-poc-to-produ.summary: Turn Todo POC lessons into a production plan for Ask IT.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Review pilot feedback from Stage 7. List what must change before real store users: secrets, logging, errors, rollback.

sections.heading: Path
sections.body: **Reads** = production concepts for Ask IT. **Labs 7A–7B** = Todo production config and runbook **with tutor**. **Assignment** = Ask IT rollout checklist **on your own**.

production-deployment/deployment-fundame.summary: Production config, env vars, dependencies, and rollback—in Ask IT terms.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- **Production configuration** — stricter than POC (no debug flags in public URLs).
- **Build and start** — how Render (or AWS) builds your repo and starts the API.
- **Environment variables** — API keys and DB URLs live in the dashboard, not in Git.
- **Dependencies** — database, model API, static frontend.
- **Rollback** — how to return to the last good deploy if something fails.

production-deployment/logging-monitoring.summary: Logs, health checks, timeouts, and safe errors users can understand.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body:
- **Structured logs** — one line per request with status and latency.
- **Health checks** — `/health` so the platform knows the API is up.
- **Timeouts** — do not hang forever on a slow model API.
- **User-facing errors** — “Try again” instead of raw stack traces.
- **Diagnosing failures** — use logs to tell model 429 vs database down.

production-deployment/lab-7a-production-.summary: Tutored lab: Todo production Render config (panel below).

sections.heading: Path
sections.body: You hardened **Todo** on Render in Stage 7. Here you add **production** rules: `render.yaml`, secret handling, CORS. Same pattern later on **Ask IT** in the assignment.

sections.heading: Panel below
sections.body: One prompt → save `PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md` → checkpoint before you close the panel.

sections.heading: Done when
sections.body: No API keys in Git, health check configured, checklist includes rollback steps.

sections.heading: Path
